description: Defines the PacketDroppingTestWriter class, a test utility for simulating packet loss, reordering, delays, and socket blocking in QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: PacketDroppingTestWriter
classes.description: A test utility class that simulates packet dropping, reordering, delays, and socket blocking for QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: PacketDroppingTestWriter::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callback when the writer is ready to write.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test writer with helper, alarm factory, and callback.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Sends a packet, potentially dropping or delaying based on configuration.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the writer is currently blocked.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Returns buffer for next write, disables zero-copy if supported.

methods.name: ReleaseOldPackets
methods.description: Flushes delayed packets that are due to be sent.

methods.name: SetDelayAlarm
methods.description: Sets alarm for delayed packet transmission.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Callback when the writer becomes writable.

methods.name: set_fake_drop_first_n_packets
methods.description: Configures dropping the first N packets unconditionally.

methods.name: set_max_bandwidth_and_buffer_size
methods.description: Sets bandwidth and buffer size for delaying packets.

methods.name: set_seed
methods.description: Sets seed for randomness, useful for reproducing flaky issues.

methods.name: ReleaseNextPacket
methods.description: Sends the next delayed packet if due.
